entries.title: A removed iPhone or iPad says so, even on a weak connection
entries.body: When you remove your iPhone or iPad in Settings → Devices, it now shows that it was removed every time. Before, a removal that reached it while it was still asking the computer for something could look like a lost connection, so it said the computer was out of reach and kept trying to reach it.
entries.noPicture: The phone shows the same Removed screen as before; only how reliably it hears the removal changed.
